Bears vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 2 · NFL Week 8 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 2, 7:59 PM ET

Jaxon Smith-Njigba has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bears at Seahawks DraftKings Showdown: 22.1 points at $12,000 FLEX, 33.2 at captain for $18,000. Across 100,000 simulations Smith-Njigba holds 67% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Smith-Njigba is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 8.3 points at a $12,000 FLEX salary, in a game with a 46.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 23.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Smith-Njigba at captain. D'Andre Swift is the next captain in line, at 15.9%. The model gives him 17.9 carries and 3.6 targets.

Seattle is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.75 for the Seahawks and 21.75 for the Bears.

Behind Smith-Njigba and Swift, the next projections are Caleb Williams (18.4, $10,200), Sam Darnold (16.6, $9,400) and Luther Burden III (12.6, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 2, 7:59 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA WR ($12,000 FLEX / $18,000 CPT)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba holds 23.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $18,000 and the 22.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 26.3 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 22.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 46.8. He holds 67% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 23.2% as the captain and 44.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: D'Andre Swift, CHI RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

D'Andre Swift holds 15.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 17.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 17.9 carries and 3.6 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Swift averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 34.8. He holds 55% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.9% as the captain and 39.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Caleb Williams, CHI QB ($10,200 FLEX / $15,300 CPT)

Caleb Williams holds 14.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,300 and the 18.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.7 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Williams averaged 18.4 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 36.6. He holds 62% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.1% as the captain and 47.6% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Barner averaged 9.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.0 and a ceiling of 24.9. Bears vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Bears vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown?

Jaxon Smith-Njigba holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 23.2%, ahead of D'Andre Swift (15.9%) and Caleb Williams (14.1%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Bears vs Seahawks?

Build around D'Andre Swift at captain with Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Sam Darnold and AJ Barner at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (119 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,300 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Bears vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown?

Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the SPAGS model at 22.1 DraftKings points for $12,000 at FLEX, or 33.2 points at captain for $18,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Bears vs Seahawks Showdown?

Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the most expensive player at $12,000 FLEX and $18,000 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Bears vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to AJ Barner (9.0 points at $4,600), Kalif Raymond (6.1 points at $3,600) and Cooper Kupp (7.8 points at $4,800).

What is the Bears vs Seahawks spread and total?

The Seahawks are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 46.5, with implied team totals of 24.75 for the Seahawks and 21.75 for the Bears.
